camel_example: aliyun sls GET /dataagents/order-analysis-agent/threads --region cn-hangzhou --threadId 'thread-tiirv9-irwdoal8t4rm' --nextToken 'e81493d42a7d212810e0ac****' --maxResults 20 --includeMission false --status active --header "Content-Type=application/json" --name 'order-analysis-agent'
description_en: Lists the sessions under a specified DataAgent. This operation supports filtering by status and session ID, and returns paginated results
description_zh: 列举指定 DataAgent 下的会话，支持按状态、会话 ID 过滤，并支持分页返回
kebab_example: aliyun sls list-threads --name order-analysis-agent --next-token 'e81493d42a7d212810e0ac****' --max-results 20 --status active --thread-id thread-tiirv9-irwdoal8t4rm --include-mission false --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListThreads

parameters.help_en: The name of the DataAgent. This parameter is passed in the request path to specify the DataAgent whose sessions you want to list
parameters.help_zh: DataAgent 的名称，通过请求路径传入，用于指定要列举哪个 DataAgent 下的会话
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The pagination cursor. Pass the nextToken value returned in the previous response to retrieve the next page. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query
parameters.help_zh: 翻页游标。传入上一次响应返回的 nextToken 可获取下一页；首次查询无需传入
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of sessions to return per page. Maximum value: 200
parameters.help_zh: 单页返回的会话条数，最大为 200
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The session status used to filter the results. The valid values are the same as the status values in the response, such as active
parameters.help_zh: 按会话状态过滤，取值与结果中的 status 一致，例如 active
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The session ID used to filter the results. Specify this parameter to query a specific session
parameters.help_zh: 按会话 ID 过滤，用于只查询某一个会话
parameters.name: thread_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to include any session that is automatically created by a mission
parameters.help_zh: 是否包含由任务（Mission）自动创建的会话
parameters.name: include_mission

schema.description_en: The response body. Returns a list of sessions that meet the filter conditions and pagination information
schema.description_zh: 响应体。返回符合条件的会话列表与分页信息

maxResults.description_en: The actual number of sessions returned per page in this query. This value is the same as the maxResults value in the request
maxResults.description_zh: 本次查询实际使用的单页条数，与请求中的 maxResults 一致

nextToken.description_en: The pagination cursor for the next page. This field is not returned if no more results are available
nextToken.description_zh: 下一页的翻页游标。没有更多结果时不返回该字段

requestId.description_en: The ID of the request. You can use this ID to locate the call during troubleshooting
requestId.description_zh: 本次请求的 ID，用于问题排查时定位本次调用

threadId.description_en: A reserved field for compatibility. This field is typically not returned. To obtain the session list, read the threads field
threadId.description_zh: 兼容保留字段，通常不返回；会话列表请读取 threads

threads.description_en: The list of sessions returned in this response. The list contains a maximum of maxResults sessions. An empty array is returned if no sessions meet the filter conditions
threads.description_zh: 本次返回的会话列表，最多包含 maxResults 个会话。没有符合条件的会话时返回空数组

additionalProperties.description_en: The attribute value, which is of the string type

attributes.description_en: The custom attributes of the session. Both keys and values are strings
attributes.description_zh: 会话的自定义属性，键与值均为字符串

createTime.description_en: The time when the session was created. The time is in ISO 8601 format with time zone information
createTime.description_zh: 会话的创建时间，采用带时区的 ISO 8601 格式

status.description_en:
The status of the session. Common values:
active: The conversation can be continued.
archived: The session is archived.
suspended: The session is suspended and waiting for additional input.
failed: The execution failed.
cancelled: The session is canceled
status.description_zh: 会话状态。常见取值：active（可继续对话）、archived（已归档）、suspended（已暂停，等待补充输入）、failed（执行失败）、cancelled（已取消）

threadId.description_en: The ID of the session. You can use this ID to initiate a conversation, or query, modify, or delete the session
threadId.description_zh: 会话 ID，用于发起对话或查询、修改、删除该会话

title.description_en: The title of the session. The title is generated by the service through content generation based on the conversation. You can call UpdateThread to modify the title
title.description_zh: 会话标题，由服务根据对话内容生成，可通过 UpdateThread 修改

updateTime.description_en: The time when the session was last updated. The format is the same as that of createTime
updateTime.description_zh: 会话最近一次更新的时间，格式同 createTime

variables.description_en: The context variables of the session

project.description_en: The name of the Simple Log Service project associated with the session
project.description_zh: 会话关联的日志服务 Project 名称

workspace.description_en: The name of the workspace associated with the session
workspace.description_zh: 会话关联的工作空间（Workspace）名称

version.description_en: The version number of the session. This number indicates the sequence in which the session was modified
version.description_zh: 会话的版本号，用于标识会话被修改的先后次序

total.description_en: The total number of sessions that meet the filter conditions
total.description_zh: 符合过滤条件的会话总数

v1_parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to include any session that is automatically created by a mission
v1_parameters.help_zh: 是否包含由任务（Mission）自动创建的会话
v1_parameters.name: includeMission

v1_parameters.help_en: The maximum number of sessions to return per page. Maximum value: 200
v1_parameters.help_zh: 单页返回的会话条数，最大为 200
v1_parameters.name: maxResults

v1_parameters.help_en: The name of the DataAgent. This parameter is passed in the request path to specify the DataAgent whose sessions you want to list
v1_parameters.help_zh: DataAgent 的名称，通过请求路径传入，用于指定要列举哪个 DataAgent 下的会话
v1_parameters.name: name

v1_parameters.help_en: The pagination cursor. Pass the nextToken value returned in the previous response to retrieve the next page. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query
v1_parameters.help_zh: 翻页游标。传入上一次响应返回的 nextToken 可获取下一页；首次查询无需传入
v1_parameters.name: nextToken

v1_parameters.help_en: The session status used to filter the results. The valid values are the same as the status values in the response, such as active
v1_parameters.help_zh: 按会话状态过滤，取值与结果中的 status 一致，例如 active
v1_parameters.name: status

v1_parameters.help_en: The session ID used to filter the results. Specify this parameter to query a specific session
v1_parameters.help_zh: 按会话 ID 过滤，用于只查询某一个会话
v1_parameters.name: threadId
